The plate spans about 360 px in the image. If it is a roughly 22-26 cm plate, that gives about 0.07 cm per pixel.

The food looks like shredded or pot-roast beef with two pieces of cooked carrot. The beef pile measures about 100 px by 60 px, which is roughly 7 cm by 4 cm. The whole food area, carrots and other pieces included, is about 12 cm by 7 cm.

I estimate the weight at about 90 g in total: roughly 70 g of meat and 20 g of carrot.

Braised beef is about 200 kcal per 100 g, so 70 g of meat is about 150 kcal. The carrots add about 10 kcal, and the sauce and fat add perhaps 20 kcal. That gives roughly 180 kcal.
